title: Legal challenges taxpayers face under the faceless assessment scheme
p1: A tax notice arriving from an unknown officer can feel confusing. But the biggest challenge in faceless assessment is not the technology — it is whether taxpayers get a fair chance to explain their side.
p2: Many believe faceless assessment means there is no personal interaction, so disputes are automatically reduced. The surprising part: taxpayers can still face issues like unclear notices, limited hearing opportunities, or difficulty presenting complex facts through a digital system.
p3: Faceless assessment aims to make tax proceedings transparent and efficient, but taxpayers must actively protect their rights. Reading notices carefully, responding within deadlines, and keeping proper records can make a major difference. A strong response is not just about submitting documents; it is about clearly explaining the facts behind those documents.
